Connecting and previewing.keepRegistryRecords: A new Library keeps records already held by the Registry.
Connecting and previewing.previewWithoutWrites: Preview leaves the proposed Library sync unapplied.
Connecting and previewing.refuseNewerFormat: Sync refuses a newer Registry format before uploading changes.

Syncing Author Workspaces.pullMissing: Sync pulls missing authored SKITs into this device without creating duplicate Collections.
Syncing Author Workspaces.propagateEdits: Sync propagates edits between connected Author Workspaces and refreshes enabled harnesses.
Syncing Author Workspaces.preserveWorkspaceFolders: Sync leaves occupied or deleted workspace folders alone and continues Library sync if a workspace is busy.
Syncing Author Workspaces.linkPulledWorkspace: A pulled workspace links to the synced Collection and updates enabled Skills offline.
Syncing Author Workspaces.mergeOfflineEdits: Overlapping offline edits to a connected Draft converge without losing either device’s history.

Choosing between changes.sendRemovals: Sync sends removals made since this Library last synced.
Choosing between changes.alignIndependentImports: Adding the same source on two devices merges into one Collection instead of duplicating it.
Choosing between changes.retainResolvedVersions: Resolving a conflict with --take-remote keeps older local Skill versions in history.
Choosing between changes.resolveCollectionRemoval: Removing a Collection on one device while editing it on another conflicts as one decision.
Choosing between changes.keepUnrelatedSelections: Sync keeps unrelated Registry choices when resolving a local selection conflict.
Choosing between changes.repeatConflictResolution: Retrying after a failed conflict resolution still requires passing --take-remote again.

Recovering interrupted work.protectLaterEdits: An unresolved earlier sync cannot silently overwrite a later edit.
Recovering interrupted work.recordMergedRevision: Sync records the Registry revision it merged before uploading local changes.
Recovering interrupted work.protectStoredCopies: Sync stops if SKIT’s stored Skill copies were modified on disk.
Recovering interrupted work.preserveRefusedSync: A refused Library sync leaves the saved Library records unchanged.
Recovering interrupted work.retryAcceptedChange: A failed Library sync can be retried without losing a Registry change already accepted.
Recovering interrupted work.rejectPartialDownload: A failed download does not save a partial fresh Library.
Recovering interrupted work.reuseVerifiedDownload: Sync reuses a verified saved download.

Keeping device choices.keepDeviceSelection: Sync keeps this device’s installation choices local.
Keeping device choices.retainAfterInstallFailure: If copying Skills to a harness fails after syncing, the synced Library is kept.
Keeping device choices.refuseUnusableHarness: If a harness skills directory is unusable before sync, sync stops without saving.
Keeping device choices.protectEditedSkills: Sync never overwrites or deletes a Skill folder you edited directly.
Keeping device choices.respectRepositoryDestinations: Sync keeps each repository’s installed Skills at that repository’s destination.
Keeping device choices.ignoreInactiveEdits: Edits left in an uninstalled harness do not block sync.
